name: Libertify LibertiVault deposit swap-callback reentrancy
summary: LibertiVault.deposit priced shares against a NAV read before its 1inch user swap and had no reentrancy guard. The attacker's swap executor re-entered deposit, so outer deposits minted shares against the stale NAV and the inflated supply was redeemed for the vault's reserves. The attacker and two copycats repeated it on the Ethereum vault.
notes: Each vault is an EIP-1167 clone of a LibertiVault master, so the clone's creation is the reset; the later rebalance invariant change is an operational value and any value below 100% enables the swap the exploit needs.

The Ethereum vault 0x429032a4 (clone of the same template) was drained by the same attacker 17 minutes after the Polygon anchor and by two flash-loan copycats; a scan of all Ethereum sibling clones found no other drain, and the Polygon siblings held only a few shares each at the anchor.
